latent_variables.name: Individual sensitivity differences
latent_variables.rationale: High heterogeneity (high) across findings suggests an unmeasured individual-difference variable moderates the effect of communities green plant yellow on alpha power wave.

latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Psychophysics / Perception, Distraction Theory, Stress Recovery Theory (Ulrich)). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of communities green plant yellow, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
